name: spector
description: Spec-driven development skills for AI coding agents — write and maintain specs and decision records.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven development for AI coding agents: write specs, record decisions.
interface.longDescription: Spector bundles spec-driven-development, documentation-and-adrs, and spec-corpus-hygiene: write a structured spec before coding, keep it and its decision records alive as the project evolves, and audit the corpus for drift between what it claims and what's true.
defaultPrompt: Write a spec for this feature before we start coding
Record this decision as an ADR
